notes.title: Traditional and Simplified Chinese Now Available!
notes.content:
Au Revoir is now accessible to even more players around the world!


Our latest update adds full support for both Simplified and Traditional Chinese — a key step in bringing the game's immersive experience to a broader audience.

Step into the year 2071 as a Sentinel working for Au Revoir Ltd. Uncover hidden truths, make impactful decisions that shape the fate of each character, and explore neon-noir environments filled with mystery, tension, and retro-futuristic vibes — now fully localized for Chinese-speaking players.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45090100/0d5afc8b29a43ccf3523a1f3c605d732a7f75177.gif"]



Get ready to revisit Au Revoir with a whole new perspective.
